tools.name: laposta_list_lists
tools.description: List all mailing lists of the Laposta account with member counts (active, unsubscribed, cleaned). Use the list_id in the other tools.

tools.name: laposta_get_list
tools.description: Get one mailing list: name, state, notification addresses and member counts.

tools.name: laposta_list_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of a mailing list (name, custom_name used as the key in custom_fields, datatype, required, options). Call this before adding or updating a member.

tools.name: laposta_list_segments
tools.description: List the segments of a mailing list (a segment id can be a campaign recipient together with its list).

tools.name: laposta_list_members
tools.description: List the members (subscribers) of a mailing list, one page at a time. Filter by state, free-text search (email and field values) or label. Contains personal data: only fetch what the task needs.

tools.name: laposta_get_member
tools.description: Get one member of a list by member id or email address: state, signup/confirm dates and custom field values.

tools.name: laposta_get_member_history
tools.description: The event history of one member (subscribed, confirmed, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed, automations ...), newest first by default. Optionally limited to one campaign or a date range. Paged by cursor.

tools.name: laposta_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the account's campaigns (name, subject, sender, recipient lists, delivery moments). Use limit/offset to page.

tools.name: laposta_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign: name, subject, preview text, sender, reply-to, recipients, delivery moments and web version URL.

tools.name: laposta_get_campaign_content
tools.description: Get the plain-text content of a campaign (and its import_url if it was imported). Set include_html to also get the full HTML (large).

tools.name: laposta_get_campaign_history
tools.description: Recipient events of one campaign (delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed ...), newest first by default, optionally within a date range. Paged by cursor. For totals use laposta_get_report.

tools.name: laposta_list_reports
tools.description: Result figures of all campaigns: sent, accepted, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed, with ratios. Use limit/offset to page.

tools.name: laposta_get_report
tools.description: Result figures of one campaign: sent, accepted, unique opens and clicks, bounces, complaints, unsubscribes and their ratios.

tools.name: laposta_add_member
tools.description: WRITE: add one email address to a mailing list (subscribe). On a double opt-in list Laposta sends the confirmation email to that address. The address must have given consent. With upsert, an existing active member's fields are overwritten; an unsubscribed member is re-activated unless suppress_react

tools.name: laposta_update_member
tools.description: WRITE: change a member's custom field values and/or email address, or unsubscribe the member (state: unsubscribed). Only the fields you pass change. Re-subscribing a person is not offered here: do it in the Laposta app or with laposta_add_member upsert only when they asked for it.

tools.name: laposta_create_campaign
tools.description: WRITE: create a new regular campaign (a draft: it is NOT filled, scheduled or sent). Fill it with laposta_set_campaign_content, check it with laposta_send_test_email and send it in the Laposta app. The from_email must be an approved sender address of the account.

tools.name: laposta_set_campaign_content
tools.description: WRITE: replace a campaign's content with your HTML, or let Laposta import it from a URL (html wins if both are given). Does not send anything. The reply's report lists problems Laposta found (javascript, missing unsubscribe link, missing images).

tools.name: laposta_send_test_email
tools.description: WRITE: send a test copy of a campaign (it must have content and not be sent yet) to ONE email address. Does not send the campaign to its recipients.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: laposta_get_list, laposta_list_members, laposta_get_member, laposta_get_campaign, laposta_get_campaign_content, laposta_add_member · Public sink: laposta_list_members, laposta_get_member, laposta_add_member, laposta_update_member, laposta_create_campaign, laposta_set_campaign_content, laposta_send_test_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: laposta_get_list, laposta_list_members, laposta_get_member, laposta_get_campaign, laposta_get_campaign_content, laposta_add_member · Public sink: laposta_list_members, laposta_get_member, laposta_add_member, laposta_update_member, laposta_create_campaign, laposta_set_campaign_content, laposta_send_test_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
